newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Fernandez expects upgrade news soon.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez expects upgrade news soon.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Minister Roque Fernandez is expecting news of an upgrade to the country's credit rating soon, according to comments published Wednesday by local media.

"On the basis of the information that we have I can say that relatively quickly, maybe in two or three weeks, Argentina's credit rating will be upgraded," he said, according to comments reported by financial dailies Ambito Financiero and El Cronista.
The statements were made in Barcelona at the annual meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank.
Argentina started lobbying the international credit rating agencies a year ago in an effort to improve its grade.

Standard & Poor's, the world's largest credit rating agency, announced last week that it is reviewing its current BB- rating on Argentine debt. It said it expected an outcome of the review in two or three weeks.
